messages.en:
{07 14 00}What do you think I should
have when I get my chow on
today, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}C'mon, help me think of
something before my belly
gets surly, {ff 00 00 05}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mis sa arvad, mida ma
peaksin täna sööma,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Ole nüüd, aita mul midagi
välja mõelda, enne kui mu
kõht pahandab,{ff 00 00 05}{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Wandering around like
this...{01 00 00 05 00} Man, my dogs are
getting hot!
{07 16 00}Ooh, y'know what? {01 00 00 05 00}I think
I'll have hot dogs for
dinner, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Niimoodi ringi hulkudes...{01 00 00 05 00}
Mees, mu jalgadel hakkab
kuum!
{07 16 00}Oi, tead mis? {01 00 00 05 00}Ma arvan,
et söön õhtuks viinereid,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I'm out walking,{01 00 00 05 00} all
kinds of crazy things go
through my head!
{07 04 00}What.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Oh, you mean right
now?

{07 0e 00}I was wondering{01 00 00 05 00} who's
meaner: judo dudes or sumo
wrestlers, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma jalutan,{01 00 00 05 00} käivad mul
peast läbi igasugused
hullud asjad!
{07 04 00}Mida.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Oh, sa mõtled
praegu?

{07 0e 00}Ma mõtlesin,{01 00 00 05 00} kes on
kurjem: judokad või
sumomaadlejad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm starving! {01 00 00 05 00}I swear,{01 00 00 05 00} my
abs and dorsal muscles
{07 0f 00}must be touching{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}But, actually,{01 00 00 05 00} now that I
think on it, this heartburn
hurts so good, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mul on kõht tühi! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma vannun,{01 00 00 05 00}
mu kõhu- ja seljalihased
{07 0f 00}peavad kokku puutuma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Aga tegelikult,{01 00 00 05 00} nüüd kui ma
mõtlen, see kõrvetus
valutab nii hästi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
